statement.p: The table below gives the average temperature, T, at a depth d, in a borehole in Belleterre, Quebec.
Evaluate \Delta T / \Delta d on the following intervals
d) Which of the statements below correctly explains the significance of your answer to part (c)? Select all that apply (more than one may apply).

li.p: The temperature is changing at a rate of 0.0053 degrees Celsius per minute when the depth is 50 meters.
On average, the temperature is changing at a rate of 0.0053 degrees Celsius per minute over the interval 50 \leq d \leq 200 .
The temperature changes by a total of 0.0053 degrees Celsius when moving from a depth 50 meters to 200 meters.
Over the interval from 50 meters to 200 meters, the temperature changes on average at a rate of 0.0053 degrees Celsius per meter.
0.0053 is the slope of the graph of at d = 50.

solution.p: a) Over the interval d = 100 to d = 225, \Delta T = 6.25 - 5.10 = 1.15 and \Delta d = 225 - 100 = 125 .
b) Over the interval d = 75 to d = 175, \Delta T = 5.75 - 5.10 = 0.65 and \Delta d = 175 - 75 = 100 .
c) Over the interval d = 50 to d = 200, \Delta T = 6.00 - 5.20 = 0.8 and \Delta d = 200 - 50 = 150 .
d) Only the statement Over the interval from 50 meters to 200 meters, the temperature changes on average at a rate of 0.0053 degrees Celsius per meter is correct. All others are incorrect:
The statement, 0.0053 is the slope of the graph of at d = 50, is incorrect since the average rate of change is the slope of the line segment connect the endpoints of the interval.

The statement, The temperature changes by a total of 0.0053 degrees Celsius when moving from a depth 50 meters to 200 meters, is incorrect since the average rate of change is a ratio of the change in temperature divided by the change in depth (not just the total change in temperature.

The statement, On average the temperature is changing at a rate of 0.0053 degrees Celsius per minute over the interval 50 \leq d \leq 200, is incorrect since the units must be degrees Celsius per meter (not minute).

The statement, The temperature is changing at a rate of 0.0053 degrees Celsius per minute when the depth is 50 meters, is incorrect since the average rate of change averages the rates of change at every point in the interval. It is not the rate of the change at just the initial depth.
